current.text: He is a projected starter for the Knicks next to Brunson, Bridges, Hart and Towns. His usage was just under 20 percent in about 33 minutes per game.
He stays the third option behind Brunson and Towns. Expect more big scoring nights when either of them rests, but he is not projected to average 25 points.
The Knicks are expected to be careful with him and their other starters. That means trimmed minutes and more rest on back-to-backs over roughly the first 30 games.
Some experts worry about a hangover after the championship run. They expect a minute or two less per game, a small rise in injury risk and some regression.
In category leagues, a rank of about 60 to 69 is fair or slightly low for him. Pick 72 is far too late.
He has the widest outcome range of the fifth round, from about 22nd at best to 89th at worst. The range comes mostly from how his steals turn out. The expert still feels confident in him.
In an expert auction mock he went for 16 USD against an expected price of about 20 USD. The expert called that still a good price.
In points leagues he is overpriced at his current rank and ADP.

durable.text: He is streaky. Hot stretches can be followed by weeks of inconsistency.
He has had knee and ankle problems over his career. He has stayed healthy for two seasons with the Knicks.
He is worth much more in category leagues than in points leagues.
Steals are his best category, and he makes plenty of threes for a forward. None of his categories is weak.

note: He is a solid mid-tier category forward with no weak category. Steals (z +1.6) and threes (2.3 per game) carry his value, so he fits any build. Yahoo values him at 16 USD and ESPN at only 5 USD. He went for 15 USD in our league last season and 16 USD in an expert mock, so about 15 to 18 USD is fair, while a rank near 69 is OK or slightly low for categories. Over roughly the first 30 games, check his minutes and back-to-back rest, since the Knicks plan to be careful with their starters. Also watch whether his steals hold up, because they decide whether he ends near his best case or his worst case.
